title: Raise the SLO alerts
prompt: Every service has two targets for each 5-minute window in `service_metrics`: a p95 latency within 800 ms, and server errors on at most 5% of requests. Complete `solve(service_metrics)` so it returns one alert row for each window that misses a target.
rules: Columns and types: `service STRING, window_start TIMESTAMP, p95_latency_ms INT, error_pct DOUBLE, alert STRING`.
`error_pct` is `error_count / request_count × 100`, rounded to 2 decimals. Compare the rounded value with the target.
A window misses the latency target when its p95 is above 800, and the error target when `error_pct` is above 5. Exactly 800 or exactly 5 is within the target.
`alert` is `latency`, `errors`, or `latency and errors` when both are missed. Windows that meet both targets have no row.
hints: Write each target as its own condition first.
In a `F.when` chain the first true branch wins, so put the case where both are missed first.
Without `otherwise`, a window that passes gets NULL; filter those out.
